blocks.html: Steeples, minarets, spires, domes, cupolas and other similar architectural elements not used for occupancy or storage, shall be constructed of materials consistent with the required type of construction of the building and shall be of a type of construction having fire-resistance ratings not less than required for the building on top of which such steeple, minaret, spire, dome or cupola is built.
